digest.component_or_area: test harness, repo isolation guards, e2e diagnostics
propositions: Detached pytest runs report failures that do not reproduce in foreground runs, but the cause is concurrent external mutations of the shared checkout, not detachment itself
The _no_repo_root_leaks guard cannot distinguish between in-test mutations and external concurrent writes, causing it to blame innocent tests and silently delete concurrent agent files
The browser e2e diagnostics fail to inspect proc.returncode, so a signal-killed child probe reports empty stderr indistinguishable from a product failure
Detached runs are trustworthy when run in a dedicated worktree with no concurrent mutations; the practice is undocumented in local-dev guidance
Guard messages must accurately name external-actor mutations as a possibility rather than asserting test causation for what they cannot attribute
